text: No tree-cover loss occurred on this asset after 2020. The analysis, covering 2021–2025, detected no stand-replacing events larger than 0.5 hectares. While the asset had 48.4 ha of tree cover in 2000 and 43.3 ha of forest in 2020, the 30 m resolution data and corroboration rules showed no subsequent loss. Changes smaller than 0.5 ha, or at edges, might be missed. The asset remains compliant with no observed deforestation during this period.
